name: Claude Code Review
desc: Multi-agent review that verifies bugs in every pull request
desc_zh: 逐个审查 PR、验证缺陷的多智能体代码评审
solves: Agents write PRs faster than people review them; Code Review dispatches agents that read each change closely.
solves_zh: 智能体写 PR 比人审得快，Code Review 派出多个智能体逐行细读每处改动。
best_for: A pull request touches a race condition and the only senior reviewer is on leave.
best_for_zh: 一个 PR 改到了竞态问题，而唯一资深评审正在休假。
